description: She wears an opaque purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, gold floral/geometric woven borders and broad central panel, round gold shoulder brooches, a gold belt with purple jewel, a cream-and-gold patterned wrap around the arms, a gold bracelet/rings and dark embroidered closed shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon.
